protocol.cold: fresh private V8-cache processes, not flushed OS caches
protocol.prewarmed: bytecode prepared on both variants; cost retained separately
protocol.worker: fresh worker and explicit definition-prepared worker; canonical result parity checked except report clocks
protocol.output: full and bounded pairs on separate Windows VMs; not an output-rendering overhead comparison
limitations: Synthetic one-phase Stories, not complete enterprise workflows or native Copilot conversations.
The amended fixture proves accepted revision 2 and its revalidation marker; it does not measure a long chain of amendments.
Timed repositories have no configured network remote; amended fixture setup uses disposable local bare configuration repositories.
Node/owned-worker calls do not include office-laptop PowerShell/.cmd, security software or Copilot-hook overhead.
OS/Git facts are not flushed; baseline and candidate can share persistent Git observations where their commands match.
Worker fact persistence is disabled, unlike CLI qualification; do not subtract the two suites.
Nested timing spans overlap; missing baseline diagnostics are unavailable, not measured zero.
Local Mac smoke timings under concurrent development are not qualification evidence.
